summary: Backend security fixes verified end-to-end. Ran full pytest suite (regression + new security tests): 35 passed, 1 skipped (skip is data-dependent, not a fix gap). SEC-003 property BOLA: Owner B gets 404 on Owner A's property, tenant without active lease gets 404, Owner A gets 200, tenant WITH active lease gets 200. SEC-003 ticket scoping: tenant without lease -> 403, foreign owner -> 403, legit tenant1 -> 200. SEC-002 webhook: no/invalid x-razorpay-signature returns 503 (placeholder secret) or 400, never 200, never marks invoice paid. SEC-004 OTP hardening: resend-otp returns 429 after 5 resends (OTP_MAX_RESENDS=5, 6th call rate-limited), and 6 wrong verify-email attempts lock the account; a subsequent resend does NOT reset otp_attempts, so verify with the NEW correct OTP still returns 400 Too many attempts. Dev route: POST /api/dev/run-daily returns 200 with ENABLE_DEV_ROUTES=true. Regression suite (26 pre-existing tests) all still green: auth signup+OTP+verify+login (403 before verify), duplicate 409, owner dashboard shape + revenue-trend, properties/units create, lease occupied 409 + tenant-not-found 404, invoices list, tenant ledger, tenant dashboard, deposits deduction persistence, tickets create/list/filter/patch(status+comment), expenses CRUD, notifications read-all, Razorpay LIVE order creation returns order_id/amount/currency/key_id (no real payment attempted), /payments/verify with bogus signature returns 400, /aadhaar/generate-otp returns 503, owner mark-paid updates invoice to paid.
action_items: No code fixes required - all security fixes hold and no regressions detected.

Before production deploy: replace RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET placeholder with the real secret from Razorpay dashboard (currently returns 503 as designed), set DEBUG_OTP=false, set ENABLE_DEV_ROUTES=false, and rotate JWT_SECRET off the value present in .env.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1043 lines, still above the 700-line threshold - consider splitting into modules (auth, properties, leases, invoices, payments, tickets, expenses, notifications, webhooks) for maintainability.
OTP_MAX_RESENDS is hardcoded to 5; consider making it configurable via env for tuning without redeploy.
Webhook guard checks 'change_this' substring in RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET as a placeholder heuristic - reasonable, but explicit min-length + non-default check would be more robust.

success_rate.backend: 100% executed (35/35 passed, 1 skipped due to test-data dependency, no failures)

seed_data_creation: Tests created a few TEST_-prefixed properties, units, tickets, expenses (expenses deleted), plus several throwaway sec_owner_* / sec_tenant_* / otp_* / lock_* users used for BOLA and OTP tests. tenant1's due invoice may end up 'paid' at run end because TestMarkPaid marks it paid (same behaviour as iteration_1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression + security suites: /app/backend/tests/test_rentify_api.py and /app/backend/tests/test_security_fixes.py. Run: cd /app/backend/tests && pytest -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Base URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env. Signup OTPs are read from /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log (DEBUG_OTP=true). Razorpay LIVE keys - never complete a real payment; only assert order creation returns 200 and /payments/verify with bogus signature returns 400. The webhook route currently returns 503 because RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is the placeholder 'change_this_webhook_secret'; once a real secret is set the guard will short-circuit on signature mismatch (400) instead. One test (TestWebhookSignature::test_webhook_no_signature_does_not_mark_paid) is data-dependent - it skips when no due invoice is available; the sibling test test_webhook_never_returns_ok_without_valid_sig unconditionally asserts the webhook never returns 200 without a valid signature.
rca_of_issue: N/A - all security fixes verified. Reproduction of each fix is captured as a test in test_security_fixes.py so future regressions will be caught automatically.
